description: Returns upcoming solar and lunar eclipses in date order with the UK peak time, the kind of eclipse and what the UK sees of it, including London contact times, coverage or totality where the Sun or Moon is above the horizon. With a place, each eclipse also shows that place's start, maximum and end, the share of the Sun covered or the Moon's height.

count.description: Maximum number of eclipses, from 1 to 10. 5 without it.

from.description: First UK date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Without it the list starts right now.

place.description: One of 24 UK places. Each eclipse then shows what that place sees, such as London, Edinburgh, Cardiff, Belfast, Leeds or Lerwick.

type.description: Solar, lunar, or any for both. Any without it.

visibleFromUk.description: True lists only eclipses that at least one UK place can see; false adds eclipses seen elsewhere. True without it.

name: list_eclipses
title: Eclipses seen from the UK
